description: Smoke wafts from a Pennsylvania Department of Environmental Protection (DEP) monitoring hole in Centralia, Pennsylvania. The town has been nearly abandoned due to an underground coal mine fire that has been burning for decades. The measured temperature at 10 feet was 187 °F (about 86 °C).
